title: Mixed Event — STRAY BAD DOG — Episode6 What I Can Do As Your Partner

meta.Episode: Episode6 — What I Can Do As Your Partner
meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD shows signs of growth, inspired by changes in Toya. One day, they'll be able to reach the heights of that legendary night. With that thought in his head, Akito learns of the man said to be the closest to surpassing RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, what is it? Did you run here?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please, talk to me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Talk? About what...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: About how you're overworking yourself, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I understand that you want to keep getting better to surpass RAD WEEKEND someday...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you'll end up collapsing before that happens at this rate. All your effort would go to waste!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm doing this knowing the risks.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If all it took was practicing like we usually do, I would already be doing that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I won't be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND if I don't do this. I have to be able to handle anything that's thrown at me and do absolutely everything I can to make it happen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What happened that night really is bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't believe what Tono said is true. You aren't the one that's holding us back...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You don't seem satisfied by that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then how about this? Let's say that at your current level, Akito, that you can't surpass RAD WEEKEND...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Doesn't that also mean we as a team still can't as well?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The first-rate performers Tono was talking about are still in the distant future. We all have to keep getting better to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please, don't do this to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When I hit a wall that other time, you told me to let you help.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That applies to you too.
We're a team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (When I joined together with Toya, I started practicing like no other to make sure I didn't disappoint him.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I finally thought that I made it to a respectable level, and we even met An and Kohane. It felt like we were actually making progress towards our goal.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Your teammates are all more talented than you realize and they may even become first-rate performers in their own right in time.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But it's too hard for me to believe that you'll be up there with them when that time comes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I know exactly what he's talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have to start working even harder if I actually want to surpass RAD WEEKEND with them.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (For now, all I can do is work as hard as I did when I first met Toya...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An! There they are!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The event's about to start.
We can talk later...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...!
Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What on earth is going on with Akito?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm really worried. He always seems so tired and won't tell us if he's actually been getting any rest...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
What if your dad tries to talk to him, An...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We already tried that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: He just said thanks for giving him some advice and sort of just shrugged it off from what I gathered...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
He wouldn't even listen to Ken?
What else can we do...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If only we could learn why he's acting the way he is now, then we might be able to come up with something...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, wait... What if we tried asking everyone over there...?
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here!
Now, let's try to...
Huh? This song...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this is nice...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
There!
Something like that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, that's so cool!
Considering it's KAITO...!
bgm_area00003

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do mean considering it's me...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. You two need to be a little more appreciative of him since he taught you about how to use a sampler.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: KAITO was playing that song...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, hello.
I didn't notice you there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, please don't mind us!
We heard a really nice song playing and started wondering where it was coming from...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Really?
I'm glad you liked it so much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But it's just three of you today?
Where's Akito...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
About that...
Do you have some time to talk?
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So that's why Akito hasn't been around lately...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know he's the stoic and hard-working type, but trying to do this all on his own seems a bit much...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Did losing do this to him?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome always looks after us, but to go this far after losing one battle...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Exactly...
There may be something even bigger eating away at Akito right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
But what could that be?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The last time I spoke with him, he seemed very anxious...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anxious...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't say for sure, but maybe Shinonome is doing this because of you, Aoyagi...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After you settled things with your father, you started getting better so fast, right...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe he saw this as a sort of warning that told him to keep up, and it started making him anxious...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why would he think that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's what I'm not sure about...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think he wants to be able to help us, especially the person that's always next to him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was under the impression that after that incident with my father, I finally reached his level...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You may not be the only person on his mind, Toya...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've all improved so much since you became a team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We have...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito wanting to keep getting better along with his teammates seems natural...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wish he'd talk to us and lean on us more. Is that too much to ask...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It could be...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, isn't that what it means to be a team?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When things aren't going well, you cheer each other up, and you make each other better when things are going your way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At the same time, it's not a good idea to constantly rely on everyone else, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But now may be the time when you need to reach out to him, especially since you're all chasing after the same dream.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Reach out to him...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Great job, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We need to help him as his teammates. I need to support him as his partner...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So that we can keep growing together...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds good.
Thanks for your help, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's time to go, you two!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay, we're back.
Let's get a hold of Akito and...

rows.Speaker: Musician
rows.Line: Hey! Is Toya here?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you! That guy from before...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry... What was your name?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Kotaro Mita!
But that's not why I'm here...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I'm supposed to be in this event with Akito today, but something's wrong with him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
With Akito?
What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: We're doing a battle event today, but this other guy, Arata Tono, just decided to crash it. Akito looked like he'd just snapped or something...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I don't know how to put it into words, but it's like he's his old self again, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
His old self...?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: You know? When you guys just became the BAD DOGS? I mean, seriously...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please, continue. Tell us everything you know.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: You guys had it pretty rough back then, right? The older musicians were picking on you, and even the crowd was always getting in your face...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I remember...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even you guys had to deal with that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We did. But that was also when we were desperately doing everything we could to get better. Akito in particular had this aura about him, even during practice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He worked so hard on trying to make it as a performer and surpass “that night”. I struggled to keep up with him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I can totally see that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome has a really good work ethic so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But what does that have to do with what's happening now?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Maybe that's how it looked to you, Toya, but not to us. That went way beyond what the rest of us called “hard-working”...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He kept at it, even when you weren't there. Day and night, regardless if he could even physically sing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I couldn't get much out of him then, but I think he was trying to keep up with you...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: With me...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, you have a classical music background, so your musical intuition is through the roof. He probably felt that someone way beyond him just came onto the scene...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Other people have even been saying that Akito is living off his partner's talents...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You're kidding! That's awful!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm the one that's holding us back.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, that's not true.
Akito, you've...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It is true. I know better than anyone else...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for telling us, Mita.
Do you know where Akito is now?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He's... He's at that live house... BROWN!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Got it...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, Toya...!
We're going too, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
